name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a standalone OpenQASM 3 program pr
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a standalone OpenQASM 3 program preparing an 3-qubit GHZ state with measurement, plus Python code that loads it with qiskit.qasm3 and samples 2000 shots. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
